study: Dynamic booking horizon: refinement outcomes, incompleteDates and latency by horizon length
protocol: 120 s cold-address booking runs, one fresh seed each. Profiles: low (6 technicians, 1 visit a day) and high (3 technicians, 2 visits a day, the first 12 weekdays at 4). Modes: fixed 10 weekdays, and dynamic (2 weekdays past the furthest weekday at least 85 percent full, at most 15). 1 and 5 desks, 3 repeats, interleaved.
hypotheses: Low volume, dynamic: 3 to 4 dates, so fewer distinct windows; more searches at or below regularWindowThreshold make the refinement required, so fewer SHED and lower latency, possibly fewer offers.
High demand, dynamic: about 19 to 21 dates, so a longer insertion pass; more DEADLINE SHORTENED and more incompleteDates, but offers on days the fixed horizon never reached.
